      Cloud Signage/Playlists

      Playlists

      This is the most important section to customize the content to be played on your display. Playlists are not uploaded, but created as per user requirements. This Overview page explains the use of every option; each one is discussed in depth on its own dedicated page.

      The Playlists page, with its top toolbar, folder tree and a tile for each playlist

      Overview

      Click Playlists in the left navigation to open this section. Every playlist you’ve built appears here as a tile.

      The whole page is on the right. It stays there as you read, and moves to each option as it comes up.

      Top toolbar

      • Total Playlists, top left, shows the total count of playlists on this account.
      • What's New is where you can read in depth about the library and playlist folders.
      • Publish Requests shows the requests made by the maker to publish or re-publish a playlist to a screen, its own queue, separate from the Library’s. The Maker-Checker permission section walks through this queue end to end.

      Sort your playlist

      Sort by Created, Sort by layouts and Sort by Screen Count are the three options to sort playlists on this page.

      Find a playlist

      search playlists ... finds a playlist by name.

      Customize your playlist

      + New Playlist takes user to the page to create and edit playlists after entering the name and optional folder detail with description.

      Create a folder

      + New Folder creates a new folder in this section.

      Folders

      Folders count here holds the groups created and the folders created specifically in this section with + New Folder option at top right.

      The playlist tile

      Every playlist tile carries the same details.

      Select a playlist

      The box on a tile selects it. Ticking it shows the count of playlists selected at the top in blue.

      The ⋮ menu

      ⋮ opens Duplicate Playlist, Update Playlist, View History and Delete Playlist.

      Preview

      The thumbnail shows a small preview of the playlist’s content.

      Publish

      Publish lets you select the screens, then publish the playlist to them.

      Edit

      Edit opens the playlist to edit it.

      Delete

      The red bin icon deletes the playlist from here.

      Playlist name

      Below the buttons is the playlist’s name.

      Layouts

      The layout count is the total layouts made in that playlist.

      Screens

      The screen count is the total number of screens that playlist is playing on.

      Created date

      The date shown is when the playlist was created.

      For detailed explanation of all the options, review Top Toolbar and Customize your playlist.
